objections.source: main p8 Eq3; issuer S1 p2 S1.B
objections.challenge: The original generative suffix context indexes n=|u|+1 while the stored context length is |u|; distinguish empty-context level n=1 from no-information return at n=0. No evidence a new unbounded depth N is learned.
objections.proposed: Clarify indexing and preconfigured maximum depth without adding new mechanism.

objections.challenge: Predicted label kt differs from stored instructed et if human errs; S1 ADD_CUSTOMER appends timestamp before stochastic termination/propagation, never rewrites earlier seats. A misses explicit immutable past timestamp constraint.
objections.proposed: Add exact order and no backward reseating as append-only clarified source condition.

objections.source: main pp9-11 Eq4; S2 pp1-2 FigA-C
objections.challenge: Initial A mentions five samples but could imply full Bayesian posterior validity. Published ABC 1000 random theta each of 10 searches, OLS rho, evaluate restricted middle RT withholding after full sequence observation; original sample numerical stability is not independently reproduced.
objections.proposed: Add holdout conditionality/5-sample approximation as explicit condition; don't assert true independent future sequence prediction.

objections.source: main pp7-9 Table1 Fig3 and p17 final proposal
objections.challenge: Language 'new learned chunks/skill' may be read as new executable learned motor macros or learned coordination policy; original conditional prediction over instructed categorical key events with pre-imposed max n. Proposed two-HCRP arbiter is explicitly future only.
objections.proposed: Restrict source-driven n-gram contexts and effective hierarchy to predictive statistics; prohibit introduction of arbiter.

objections.source: issuer S2 pp3-6 Eq1-4 FigD-F, main p20 §2.8
objections.challenge: Four ablations contain meaningful partial successes; UCRP independently captures temporal smoothing, trigram near matches global RT variance; do not misstate HCRP uniqueness or treat modality as model-family difference.
objections.proposed: Register ablation partial successes and the task-specific model comparison conditional outcomes.

objections.challenge: Unadjusted reported WM r and p look favorable yet BOTH fail BH across 24 tested correlations; source authors dispute conservativeness, but published non-survival is material adverse.
objections.proposed: Explicitly retain both unadjusted and BH-corrected values and interpretation as exploratory only.

objections.challenge: Old/new parallel behavioral stability versus single HCRP false oscillation is decisive original model failure. Figure7 >2 group nonsignificant endpoints; proposed meta-learner is not source-implemented.
objections.proposed: Carry signed observed/model divergences as fidelity targets, do not invent a second model/supervisor.

objections.challenge: Model response term is explanatory regressor for actual log RT; experimenter external stimuli and actual k observed. Original differential error subtypes reflect performance, not proof that inferred latent seating literally exists in humans.
objections.proposed: Mark observed/regression inferred boundary and original source-specific error analysis.
